clue.text: A following wind may be kept waiting

definitions.text: A following wind may be kept waiting

parts.words: A following wind may be kept waiting
parts.note: a breeze from behind chills the backs of your feet, while the idiom means being made to wait around

explanation.surface: A sailor notes that a tailwind can leave a ship idling.
explanation.walkthrough: A wind blowing from behind literally cools the back of the feet; the phrase also means to be left waiting.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom describes standing about idly while someone keeps you waiting.

clue.text: Distraught rector I solaced in somewhat hypocritical display of grief

indicators.note: distraught means very upset or disordered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A clergyman is consoled while upset, though his grief seems a bit insincere.
explanation.definitionFit: Crocodile tears are a show of sorrow that is not sincerely felt.

clue.text: Unusual state observed in mineral

indicators.note: seen within, so the abbreviation sits inside the rock

parts.note: ore is mineral-bearing rock
UT is the postal abbreviation for Utah, a US state

explanation.surface: An odd condition has been noticed in a mineral sample.
explanation.definitionFit: Outre means bizarre or unconventional.

clue.text: Where attackers went to extremes

explanation.surface: Soldiers charging out went too far.
explanation.walkthrough: In First World War trench warfare, attacking troops climbed out of the trench, going over the top.
explanation.definitionFit: Attacking soldiers climbed the trench parapet; the phrase also means excessive or exaggerated.

clue.text: Take advantage of daring deed

explanation.surface: Make the most of a bold feat.
explanation.definitionFit: To exploit is to use unfairly; an exploit is also a bold feat or adventure.

clue.text: Characteristic of fire-walker in haste

explanation.surface: Someone walking on coals moves quickly.
explanation.definitionFit: Walking across embers would leave the feet burning; hotfoot also means hurriedly.

clue.text: Every European army cherished heroic leaders

indicators.note: leaders are the opening letters of the four words that come before it

explanation.surface: All European armies honoured their heroic commanders.
explanation.definitionFit: Each and every both refer to all the individual members of a group.

clue.text: Weak fellow opening unfinished sleeping draught

parts.note: a sop is a feeble, spineless person

indicators.note: not completed, so the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: an orifice is an opening

explanation.surface: A feeble man starts an incomplete sleeping potion.
explanation.definitionFit: A soporific is a drug or drink that induces sleep.

clue.text: Visionary scientist finally devised scanner of teeth

indicators.note: finally points to the last letter of the word scientist
devised means worked out or contrived, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: dental means relating to teeth

explanation.surface: A scientist with vision invented a machine for scanning teeth.
explanation.definitionFit: Transcendental means spiritual or mystical, beyond ordinary experience.

clue.text: In a predicament, but equal to the occasion

explanation.surface: Someone is in trouble yet rises to the challenge.
explanation.definitionFit: Put on the spot means awkwardly cornered; being there at the moment also means ready and capable when needed.

clue.text: Head right in pursuit

parts.note: a cape is a headland, a head of land jutting into the sea

explanation.surface: A command to chase someone, with the head going right.
explanation.definitionFit: A caper is a frolic or escapade, an activity someone gets up to.

clue.text: It's evident how 3 starts

indicators.note: only the opening stretch of the answer to clue 3 is kept, the tail being dropped

parts.note: the answer to 3 down, the phrase for going to extremes

explanation.surface: A remark that something is obvious from the way it begins.
explanation.walkthrough: 3 down is OVER THE TOP; its first five letters give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Overt means open and plainly visible, not hidden.

clue.text: Musician in love has sweetheart, according to rumour

indicators.note: what is heard by rumour is the spoken form of the words before it

parts.note: love is O (a zero score in tennis) and a sweetheart is a beau, so O followed by BEAU

explanation.surface: A musician in love is said to have a sweetheart.
explanation.definitionFit: An oboe can stand for its player, as in the oboe in an orchestra.

clue.text: I was in charge of the country

parts.note: to run a business is to be in charge of it, so the past tense is ran

explanation.surface: A former leader boasts of having governed the nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Iran is a nation in western Asia.

clue.text: Wild revelry is a natural development

indicators.note: a development is a change or evolution, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Unrestrained partying is just a natural thing to happen.
explanation.walkthrough: Saturnalia was the ancient Roman winter festival of riotous celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: Saturnalia, from the Roman festival, now means any period of unrestrained merrymaking.

clue.text: Investigation in France that cuts into this month

indicators.note: the French word slices into the abbreviation, so it goes inside

parts.note: INST (instant) is the old business abbreviation for this month
que is French for that

explanation.surface: A French inquiry that is interrupted during the current month.
explanation.definitionFit: An inquest is an official inquiry, especially into a death.

clue.text: Nimble Paddies get up and dance

parts.note: quick means nimble or agile

indicators.note: in a down clue going up means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: a paddy is a fit of temper, and pets are sulks or tantrums

explanation.surface: Agile Irishmen rise and start to dance.
explanation.walkthrough: Paddy is British slang for a tantrum; 'get up' turns PETS into STEP.
explanation.definitionFit: A quickstep is a fast ballroom dance.

clue.text: Craft, if at sea, constitute this

definitions.text: Craft, if at sea, constitute this

indicators.note: at sea means confused or all over the place, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Ships out on the ocean make up a stream of movement.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: boats on the water make up shipping traffic.
explanation.definitionFit: Traffic is the movement of vehicles or vessels, which many boats together form.

clue.text: Part of a story is written in verse

indicators.note: the short word is put down inside the poem, so it is placed within

parts.note: an epode is a kind of lyric poem or verse form

explanation.surface: A section of a tale composed in poetry.
explanation.definitionFit: An episode is one instalment or section of a longer narrative.

clue.text: Attendant to sovereign. English king, called into question

indicators.note: the letter is placed inside the word for question

parts.note: a query is another word for a question
R stands for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A royal servant: an English king who was challenged.
explanation.definitionFit: An equerry is an officer who attends a member of the royal family.

clue.text: Very small amount of gruel given to convict

parts.note: gruel is a thin porridge, loosely a soup
con is short for convict

explanation.surface: A prisoner is handed only a tiny portion of gruel.
explanation.definitionFit: A soupcon is a tiny trace or hint of something.

clue.text: Children accept a little money or finance

indicators.note: to accept is to take in, so the coin's letter goes inside

parts.note: sons are children
P (penny) is a small amount of money

explanation.surface: Kids take a small sum or fund something.
explanation.definitionFit: To sponsor is to pay for or back a person or event.

clue.text: Low-ranking airmen have a penny deducted from fringe benefits

indicators.note: taking something away from the following word, so the coin's letter is removed

parts.note: perks are extra benefits on top of pay
P is the abbreviation for a penny

explanation.surface: Junior air force men see their job perks docked by a penny.
explanation.walkthrough: ERKS is British slang for the lowest-ranking members of the Royal Air Force.
explanation.definitionFit: Erk is RAF slang for an aircraftman of the lowest grade.

clue.text: Card game said to be the forerunner of party game

indicators.note: the first piece comes before the second in the answer
said signals the sound of the card game's name is wanted, not its spelling

parts.note: loo is an old card game
a do is a party or celebration

explanation.surface: A card game is said to have led on to a party game.
explanation.walkthrough: LUDO is a simple board game with counters and a die.
explanation.definitionFit: Ludo is a board game played with dice and coloured counters.

clue.text: Henry employed in agreeable and fitting post

indicators.note: taken on inside, so the letter goes within the following word

parts.note: nice means pleasant or agreeable
H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: Henry has a pleasant and suitable job.
explanation.definitionFit: A niche is a role or position that suits someone well.

clue.text: Refuse to tease

explanation.surface: Decline to make fun of someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaff is husks and rubbish separated from grain; to chaff is also to banter or rib.

clue.text: A low point for Phoebe

parts.note: to low is to make the sound a cow makes, a moo
N (north) is a compass point

explanation.surface: Phoebe has a moment of weakness.
explanation.walkthrough: Phoebe is a poetic name for the moon, after the Greek moon goddess.
explanation.definitionFit: Phoebe was a title of Artemis as moon goddess, so it names Earth's satellite in poetry.

clue.text: Loss of house by Hamlet's friend is kept in proportion

indicators.note: losing something means it is taken away from the friend's name

parts.note: Horatio is Hamlet's loyal friend in Shakespeare's play

explanation.surface: Hamlet's friend loses his house but keeps a sense of proportion.
explanation.definitionFit: A ratio is the proportional relation between two quantities.

clue.text: Following about Muslim ruler, leader of 'Turkey

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a sultan is a Muslim sovereign

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, so only that one is taken

explanation.surface: Following on from a sultan, the head of the Turkish state.
explanation.definitionFit: Resultant means coming as a consequence of something.

clue.text: Shoot down flyer and end up in sensational book

indicators.note: shooting a flyer down sends it crashing in pieces, so the letters are wrecked and rearranged

explanation.surface: Downing an airman and finishing in a lurid thriller.
explanation.walkthrough: A PENNY DREADFUL was a cheap, sensational Victorian story paper.
explanation.definitionFit: Penny dreadfuls were cheap lurid serial stories sold in Victorian Britain.
